analysis.title: SK Hynix (000660.KS) 3Q26 Review: Robust Earnings and Attractive Shareholder Returns
key_insights: SK Hynix reported 3Q26 operating profit of W83.3tr, up 38% QoQ and 632% YoY, with an operating margin of 80%. Rising memory ASPs and more high-value products drove the result despite FX headwinds.
3Q26 DRAM bit growth was +10% QoQ, with server DDR5 shipments up more than 40% QoQ. DRAM ASP rose high-20% QoQ on conventional DRAM price increases and a higher HBM4 mix.
3Q26 NAND bit growth declined slightly QoQ as the mix shifted to 321L TLC and eSSD. NAND ASP rose mid-20% QoQ on stronger pricing and a higher SSD mix.
Hynix guides 4Q26E DRAM bit growth up mid-20% QoQ on 1cnm expansion and the M15X HBM4 ramp. It guides NAND bit growth up mid-single-digit % QoQ on 321L eSSD shipments.
For 2027E the company sees achievable DRAM/NAND bit growth of mid-20%/high-teen% YoY. Long-term agreements cover more than 50% of 2027-28E capacity.

Hynix views DRAM/HBM as effectively sold out through 2029E, including customer volumes under discussion. Customer requests exceed 2x available supply. HBM spec issues could be largely offset by higher capacity per die.
Hynix announced a ~W100tr FY26 shareholder return plan: ~W30tr cash dividends and ~W60tr buybacks/cancellations, including the earlier W40tr buyback.

3Q26 dividends of ~W14tr (DPS W20K) include a W10K special dividend from Kioxia investment gains. An additional W20tr buyback was announced, W10tr of it for cancellation and the rest for employee compensation, which is excluded from shareholder returns.
Management plans to continue quarterly buybacks and views the share price as undervalued relative to earnings and cash generation.

Citi raises 4Q26E operating profit to W107tr from W89.8tr and raises 26E/27E operating profit estimates by 7%/12%. It forecasts ~W35tr of 4Q26E shareholder returns (~W15tr buyback, ~W20tr dividend). It reiterates Buy with an unchanged W3mn target price.

market_movers.rationale: Robust 3Q26 results, a constructive memory outlook and a ~W100tr FY26 shareholder return plan. Citi sees 123.7% expected price return from W1,341,000 and raises 26E/27E operating profit estimates.

sector_views.rationale: Supply growth is limited and server demand is strong. HBM/DRAM is described as sold out through 2029E, with customer requests above 2x supply.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 reported operating profit W83.3tr (+38% QoQ, +632% YoY), OPM 80%. 3Q26 sales W104,615bn, of which DRAM W77,959bn and NAND W25,806bn.
3Q26 DRAM operating profit W64,543bn (83% margin) and NAND operating profit W18,201bn (71% margin), per Citi's quarterly table.
Citi 4Q26E estimates: sales W131,441bn, operating profit W107,018bn (81% margin), up from the prior 4Q26E operating profit of W89.8tr.
Citi FY estimates: 2026E sales W367,952bn, operating profit W288,505bn, net profit W256,143bn, EPS W351,844. 2027E sales W578,881bn, operating profit W454,404bn, net profit W344,148bn, EPS W472,729.
Citi 4Q26E DRAM bit growth +25% QoQ, ASP +9% QoQ. NAND bit growth +5% QoQ, ASP +15% QoQ.
risk_factors: NAND demand weaker than Citi's forecasts.
HBM spec issues, which management says could be largely offset by higher capacity per die.
